projectDescription: A custom browser-based music player for the Summer 6ix Pack album, featuring a frosted-glass UI, full playback controls, progress scrubbing, and a 6-track playlist.
keyFeatures: Play, pause, skip next, and skip previous controls
Current time and total duration display
Scrollable 6-track playlist with active track highlighting
Auto-advance to next track on completion
Cover art display with customizable artwork
publicApiSurface: data-src attribute on .track-item elements (MP3 file path)
loadTrack(index) — loads a track by playlist index
audio timeupdate event for progress sync
audio loadedmetadata event for duration display
